findings.summary: The member-name type and guard are TypeScript's own (ts.MemberName, ts.isMemberName) instead of a re-declared pair, and the guards the parser already guarantees on property-access names are gone.

One resolver reads a member's property from the instantiated type's member list for the struct fields, the field type and the shared-return walk, so a private field of a generic class stores its argument type instead of the type parameter.

A node's data type is read through the symbol for a private name, which the checker types as any on the name node, so a private field assigned in the constructor takes the same typed data path as a public one.

Temporary labels are sanitized once in the allocator instead of at eight call sites, which also covers the initial-value label those sites missed; the private prefix is spelled at the one struct-field site where it keeps #x apart from _x.

The environment entry points nothing private reaches keep their identifier type; the ones the class-field path reaches, and the interface that had drifted from its implementation, are the member-name type.
A private name compiles through the identifier's own value branch, a brand check refuses where its value is asked for, and the in-operator special case is gone.

The native method arm's member tables key private names like identifiers, so a method touching a private member keeps its native body; nineteen public/private probe pairs lower identically up to the spelling.
The read-only parameter check is computed once per binding and shared by both conditions.
The feature row changes only its private-name half, the brand-check test is the minimal shape, and the fixture stores a generic class with private fields.
The class lowerers keep nine hand-rolled member loops where one member table would key every member once.
findings.blockedBy: The nine loops filter members differently (static, initializer, body, accessor pairs) and rely on first-match order for overloads; folding them needs a generated-tree proof over consumers no registry scene reaches, a measurement this branch's neutrality run does not take.
